You control at least one Saproling.

description:
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing a nontoken creature you control and Slimefoot and Squee.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia abilities, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creatures' powers.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two of {B}{B}, {R}{R} or {G}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
